# NevTan Partner Program

> Refer clients to NevTan Workspace and earn commission on what they pay. The commission rate and payout terms are agreed with each partner when they are approved. NevTan bills and supports the clients. Every NevTan Workspace plan includes NevTan Mail, Drive, Engage, Sign and Cloud; NevTan AI and Office are free for every client.

## Pages

- [Home](https://partner.nevtan.com/): The program at a glance — terms, the apps you can refer, who it's for and how it works.
- [Plans](https://partner.nevtan.com/pricing): Live NevTan Workspace plans and the list prices clients pay.
- [Products](https://partner.nevtan.com/products): Every NevTan app you can refer, with a page for each.
- [How it works](https://partner.nevtan.com/how-it-works): The five steps from applying to your first payout.
- [FAQ](https://partner.nevtan.com/faq): Questions about the program, commission, referrals and products.
- [Apply](https://partner.nevtan.com/apply): The application form. Applications are reviewed within one business day.
- [NevTan Workspace pricing](https://workspace.nevtan.com/pricing): The list prices clients pay, and the page partner referral links open.
